frameworksCaption: The top two bands are the standard picture: two ages, overlapping since the resurrection. The third band is Adrio König’s correction, and it is the one that changes how you preach it. The end is not a date at the far right of the line. It is a person running underneath the whole of it, for us at the cross, in us by the Spirit, with us at his coming. Time passing does not move you closer to the end, because the end is someone you are already in.
readingTie: This is not a book review column.  It’s just a window into books I’m currently reading, studying, or drawing from.
kitNote: Every template is typography and your own photography, so nothing depends on borrowed images. The formats are the part that is culturally fluent: the two panel setup, the text thread, the burned in caption. Those read as native on Instagram and TikTok without borrowing anyone else’s picture.
studiesDek: Guided studies you can walk through on your own or with a group. You read the passage, you mark it yourself, and the discussion is built from what you noticed — not from questions somebody else wrote.
studiesNote: Pay attention to what gets your attention.
heroGospelLine: Jesus is King.|His freedom, peace and purpose are available now.
essaysHeader: The kingdom already started. It has not finished. We are living in the overlap.
